recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-perspective photograph of a five-member male group wearing matching cyan-blue mod suits, posing dynamically on a vintage black steam locomotive. The composition is framed by bold, blocky purple typography at the top and a graphic octagonal sign element on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the train boiler leads the eye from the bottom right to the top left.
The bright cyan of the suits contrasts sharply against the dark, oily textures of the locomotive.
The heavy, flat purple header text anchors the top of the frame against the bright sky.
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the train and figures.
Matching monochromatic blue suits on all subjects.
A vintage steam engine as the primary setting.
A high-contrast, slightly desaturated 1960s film aesthetic.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The band members are distributed across the front and top of the locomotive, occupying the central vertical third of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, circular white front of the steam engine boiler acts as a secondary anchor to the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bottom figure, follows the vertical line of the train up to the group, then moves to the large purple header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top third of the image is mostly bright, overexposed sky, providing space for the primary typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing and graphics against the low-value, dark locomotive body.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, geometric sans-serif with extreme horizontal expansion.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters.
Horizontal emphasis where letters are wider than they are tall.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is a solid rectangle with a tiny square counter.
The 'S' consists of three stacked horizontal bars connected by thin vertical segments.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the heavy header with thin, geometric line-art lettering inside graphic shapes.
graphicDevices: Octagonal 'stop sign' shape with thin white internal border.
Circular emblem on the train boiler with concentric rings.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary horizontal stretch and squareness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of five men in cyan mod suits posing on a vintage black steam locomotive. The background is a bright, slightly overexposed sky with green trees on the edges. The lighting is natural daylight with high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-bold, purple geometric title at the top. Add an orange-red octagonal sign on the left with thin white sans-serif lettering inside.

verificationChecks: Are the suits a consistent cyan-blue?
Is the header text purple and extremely wide?
Is the locomotive black and detailed?

mustRedesign: Specific serial numbers on the train
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the purple text does not have a drop shadow.
Check that the blue of the suits is vibrant cyan.
Verify the octagonal sign is orange-red, not pure red.
Confirm the train wheels are visible at the bottom left.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle mod photography + Cyan/Black contrast + Ultra-wide geometric typography = 1960s Retro-Rock Aesthetic.
